missing: A direct, tested pick of a complete plug-in kit with battery for an apartment: current price for the full bundle (microinverter + panels + battery + railing mount), confirmed UL 3700 status, which states/utilities it is legal in today, and measured daily yield and payback from a real balcony.
why: No major reviewer or authority tests plug-in balcony solar with a battery; the famous names here are a TechRadar power-station deal post, a UK Anker review and off-target Tom's Guide/T3/Kiplinger pages. Three niche sites (plugshine, solutionenergy, solarwaypoint) answer with specs, certification notes and prices but no testing anyone can check, and the rest either skip the battery or refuse to pick. This looks like the solar generator kit win: a focused page with current bundle prices, tested codes, certification status and a direct battery-kit pick would stand out.
